question: Does lz.qaiu.top enforce a per-client request limit above the volume measured, and what is the figure behind the owner's Referer announcement?
why: the announcement (issue 197, June 2026) says requests with no Referer header may be rate limited from August 2026 and gives no figure; 100 parallel Referer-less requests from one address were all answered 200 within about five seconds, which bounds a per-address limit from below only; asking the owner needs a GitHub account (behind a sign-up) and a sustained-volume probe was not run
